about: Speech-term test (AI design §9.2). Read each sentence aloud, naturally, and save it as <id>.wav / .mp3 / .flac in one folder per microphone (for example recordings/laptop/01.wav). 12 sentences, 60 curriculum terms. Each recording is one transcription request, so one microphone uses 12 of the ~20 free daily requests.

sentences.text: TypeScript generics with a discriminated union let narrowing work without casts, and strictNullChecks catches the rest.
In Angular, a standalone component gets its data through input signals and uses dependency injection for the HttpClient.
With RxJS I pipe the stream through debounceTime and switchMap, then call toSignal so the template stays reactive.
The NestJS module registers a controller, a provider and a guard, and validation pipes check every DTO.
Prisma generates a typed client from the schema, and migrations run against PostgreSQL inside Docker Compose.
An index on the foreign key avoids a sequential scan, and EXPLAIN ANALYZE shows the query plan with its cost.
Passwords are hashed with argon2 or bcrypt, the session cookie is httpOnly and sameSite, and OAuth handles delegated login.
Idempotency keys make retries safe, while a message queue like Kafka or RabbitMQ decouples the producer from the consumer.
Kubernetes runs pods behind a Service, an Ingress routes the traffic, and a ConfigMap holds the settings.
On AWS the app keeps files in S3, uses IAM roles for access, sends logs to CloudWatch and sits behind an ALB.
Observability combines structured logs, Prometheus metrics, OpenTelemetry traces and SLOs with an error budget.
A RAG pipeline splits documents into chunks, stores embeddings in a vector database, and the LLM answers with citations.
